metadata.purpose: Retain a bounded trailing suffix while immediately forwarding any value forced out by newer arrivals.

conditions: For a finite successful source of N values output the first max(0,N-n) in order.
A value is forwarded on arrival of the n-th subsequent source value, without a clock.
Completion and cancellation never flush the retained suffix.

scope.parameters: Finite nonnegative safe integer count in 0..8; zero represents the identity fast path.
scope.callbacks: No selector or user callback; FIFO logic only.
scope.time: Emission occurs on the n-th later source next; no timer is created.
scope.reentrancy: State replacement precedes notification; nested source emissions are outside this bounded model.
exclusions: Negative, fractional, infinite and huge allocation counts; arbitrary reentrant sources or observers.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Subscribe to the source lazily on downstream subscription.

ownership.sharing: No Subject or sharing. Each result subscription owns its FIFO and source subscription.
ownership.reset: New FIFO and seen counter per subscription; release memory on terminal/cancel.

dispatch.actionSemantics: On overflow, swap FIFO head before forwarding it downstream; never emit the trailing suffix.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between reactions, on source termination and on downstream cancellation.

controls.description: source is live with subscription-local state
terminal or cancelled; no further source notifications legal
